findings.summary: The one production line that makes the new cold-exit `turn_finished` synthesis work — `getCurrentTurn: () => turnTrackerRef.current?.current()` (supervisor.ts:300), plus its late-binding assignment at :317 — is exercised by no test: the new tests re-implement that wiring locally (makeWorker builds its own `turnTrackerRef`), so deleting/breaking it in `runSupervisor` silently re-introduces r1-c1-correct-2 while the whole suite stays green.
findings.failure_scenario: A refactor inside `runSupervisor` drops (or mis-wires to a null/stale ref) the `getCurrentTurn` line — e.g. someone re-extracts the controller construction and forgets the late-bound getter. Real worker sequence: `send --to worker m1` -> turn 1 adapter `done` (latch set, turn popped); `send --to worker m2` -> turn 2 begins (onIdleExit -> resetTerminalEmitted -> latch false); the worker process then crashes (SIGSEGV, no shutdown request). `finalizeOnExit` sees latch=false and shutdownReason=null, appends `error{by:worker,synthesized:true}` — but `getCurrentTurn?.()` returns undefined, so the `turn_finished` at shutdown.ts:242-251 is skipped. events.jsonl ends with `turn_started/msg:2` and no boundary; `trellis channel wait --kind turn_finished` (AC1) never matches and only returns on its timeout; a consumer reconstructing turns sees an unterminated turn. AC1 is violated in production, yet all 10 tests in channel-supervisor-shutdown.test.ts pass.
findings.evidence: Mutation test in a scratch copy of the package ($TMPDIR/c1r2/cli, repo untouched): removed exactly the line `getCurrentTurn: () => turnTrackerRef.current?.current(),` from src/commands/channel/supervisor.ts and ran `npx vitest run test/commands/channel-supervisor-shutdown.test.ts` -> 'Test Files 1 passed, Tests 10 passed' — identical to the unmodified baseline. Contrast with the two production sites that ARE guarded: deleting `args.shutdown.resetTerminalEmitted();` inside createSupervisorTurnHooks -> 2 tests fail (the two `expect(shutdown.hasTerminalEvent()).toBe(false)` assertions); deleting the `if (turn) { ... turn_finished ... }` block in shutdown.ts -> 3 tests fail (turn-2-crash, clean-cold-exit-with-turn, `wakes wait --kind turn_finished`). The test file never imports `runSupervisor` (grep of the imports at test:9-26 confirms), so the whole supervisor-level wiring — controller-before-tracker ordering and the late-bound getter — has no coverage; the spec's 'Cold-exit fallback synthesis' row (commands-channel.md, Tests Required) is specified as an e2e test through the real supervisor, which is also not what was written. Baseline on the unmodified tree: `npx vitest run test/commands/channel-supervisor-shutdown.test.ts` -> 10 passed; full `test/commands/channel` -> 152 passed; `pnpm --filter @mindfoldhq/trellis typecheck` and `lint` clean; 5 consecutive runs of the new file -> 10 passed each (no observed flakiness).
findings.reproduction_hint: Copy packages/cli to $TMPDIR (symlink node_modules to the real one), delete supervisor.ts:300, run vitest on the new test file.
